clause_evidence.reasoning: The packet requires learners to determine answers through true-false, choice, blank, error-check, and representation tasks.
The samples present meaningful prompts involving groups, count-forward situations, number bonds, and number-line tasks.
Several printed samples use EmojiPictorial, NumberBond, or NumberLine visual representations tied to the addition task.
Every cited item asks learners to combine addends or count forward, and the provided calculations consistently use addition.
The displayed answers range from 2 through 20, and no printed sample has a sum exceeding the required upper bound.
